blocks.text: Zscaler provides a complete suite of libraries and tools for interacting with the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange. Whether you're testing APIs, building automations, or integrating with existing systems, Zscaler provides the right tools for every use case.

blocks.item: When to use Postman vs. SDKs for different scenarios
How to set up both tools in under 5 minutes
Best practices for authentication and error handling
Real-world examples and common automation patterns

blocks.text: The Zscaler Postman collection simplifies working with all API endpoints, allowing you to:

blocks.item: Test APIs instantly without writing code
Debug requests with detailed response information and analysis

blocks.text: The Postman collection is best for API exploration, testing, and quick prototyping.
To learn more, see Configuring the Postman REST API Client
Zscaler provides an official SDK for popular programming languages to accelerate development. SDKs are best used for production automations, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise integrations.
Current support is available for Authentication Service, Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX), and Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA). Additional product support will be introduced in future releases.
To learn more, see Getting Started with the Zscaler Python SDK.

blocks.item: Supports multi-product (Authentication Service, Client Connector, Cloud & Branch Connector, External Attack Surface Management (EASM), Workflow Automation, ZDX, ZIA, and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA))
Uses the OneAPI framework with a single OAuth2 client
Is backward compatible with legacy APIs
Contains built-in retries and error handling
